'''Timo Dusel''' finished '''#1''' at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] and '''#18''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (lost Round of 32; Challonge seed 8). <ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026)</ref><ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
